behavior: The repo has mapgrain diagrams of the full invoice receiver contract workflow and the invoice states, checked against PLAN.md Phase 5 and the Phase 6 state machine
acceptance: docs/diagrams/contracts-workflow.json and docs/diagrams/invoice-lifecycle.json pass mapgrain@0.2.5 validate, and each has a committed .html viewer built from it

The workflow covers: one-time factory deploy at the same address on every testnet, predict, plain transfer, detection, expiry and late checks, partial top-up, finalized wait, lazy deploy, settle to the fixed recipient, held funds, claim, platform approval, EIP-712 refund, wrong-network or wrong-token recover, and the unsupported-network case
Every money rule shown matches PLAN.md D-03..D-08, C-03, C-04 and Phase 5 design; no step lets the executor send funds anywhere but the recipient
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by reviewer: Both JSON files pass mapgrain@0.2.5 validate; committed .html viewers are byte-identical to a fresh 'mapgrain view' build. Accept 2: every case present (setup, predict, send, detect, intime/expiry, partial->send top-up w14, final, deployed/deploy lazy, settle, held, claim, approve, refundsig/refund, support/supported/recoversig/recover, lost). Accept 3: settle only after finalized (w12->final->intent), executor-only settle to fixed recipient with min(balance, amount-settled); late deposit (w11) and expired partial (w15/w16) go to held, never settled; overpay excess held (w25); refund/recover signed by refundAuthority, one refund, never touches settled funds; no auto-refund to exchange sender; no reopen of expired in lifecycle; D-14 recovery never promised. Cosmetic notes, not blocking: (1) lifecycle l2 detected->open on reorg should return to partial when a top-up is reorged; (2) lifecycle 'settled' and 'expired' carry marker final but have outgoing edges l10/l11; (3) node labels refund/recover omit nonce, deadline from the PLAN signatures (refundsig description has them); (4) 'supported' decision merges network support and admin approval, no 'supported but rejected' outcome; (5) 'where' decision sits in the payer lane though it is a fact checked by support; (6) setup description lists all four testnets while C-01 adds Arc/Tempo after spikes.
